General rational enumeration TERMINATES but has no proved polynomial global worst-case bound. For fixed one-species R, a<T_R and increments bounded by Delta give O_R(L)-bit activity brackets, O_R(L) bisections and ordinary positive rational output of polynomial binary length. All finite compiler/class tables/moment calls are paid in computable C_R,p_R. No sampler, optimizer, moment evaluator or reaction program is executed by Capital.

The compiler computes fixed primitive v, J,V,S and DDB1 cost constants from fixed R, including its finite preprocessing/table cost. All q brackets, uniform-tail constants, finite-difference values/precisions, rational bisection grid and ordinary lambda output use O_R(L) bits and O_R(L) value-call iterations, yielding computable C_R(1+L)^p_R every-run deterministic BIT work/memory/output. Numerical populations, qhi, U, Lip and epsilon^-1 are NEVER enumerated. No calibration/moment/sampling algorithm is executed by Capital.

Unimolecularcompiler uses finite complexgraph/linkage decomposition and fixednumberofrational additions: outputO_R(L) bits, work polynomial_R(L), no normalizer/moment/samplingoracle. Adaptivework polynomial_R(L+Bstar), whereBstar is NUMERICAL sufficient log-radius, not bitsBstar; off-promise radius trials must terminate under an explicit computable per-trial step cap. Finitewitnessregularization yields radiusO((K0+d+1)/epsilon), orO_d((H+1)^2/epsilon); numericalH/epsilon^-1 can be exponentiallylarge in completebinaryL. No globalpolynomial-L inference follows.
